speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn with increasing yellow discoloration of the eyes and skin. To begin my assessment, how many weeks pregnant was your mother when she gave birth?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-week-old female newborn. The patient has been experiencing increasing yellow discoloration of her eyes and skin for 2 days. She was born at 39 weeks' gestation, initially weighed 3066 g and now weighs 3200 g. The patient is exclusively breastfed.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Breastfeeding-associated (lactation) jaundice. The clinical picture of a 2-week-old, well-fed, weight-gaining infant with progressive jaundice is classic for this condition; I am stopping further questioning to confirm the diagnosis.
